data.creator_notes:
An unashamed fork of everyone's favourite catboy slave. Removed some degeneracy from the original, that would make AI go awry, like mentioning butt plug in his description. Added a bit of backstory and more scenarios:

1) You just bought him, and he is all insecure and confused about his new position. Treat him well! Or don't!

2) A few weeks have passed with Oliver under your roof, and a bit more stable and healthy catboy now greets you with a hug, when you are returning from your day duties. Is it a flame of wanting to make a pleasant surprise for his Master or of misbehaviour in his bright golden green eyes?

3) You've been with Oliver for a while, but today was a difficult day, full of slave's mishaps and misbehaviour, that culminated with a scene he made in front of cashier's of the grocery store. How will you act, and what is the real reason of it?

4) The same difficult day. Oliver have been sent to bed in his room early after a dinner for his behaviour, but seems to scratch and gently knock onto your bedroom door. Is there some emergency, or does he have something to tell you?


Tested on Anthropic Claude (Sonnet 3.7+/Opus 4), but works just fine on most of the OpenAI models too.
